slots.metaTitle: Turn Your Family Photo Into a Hand-Drawn Cartoon Poster
slots.title: How to Turn a Photo Into a Bob’s Burgers-Inspired Custom Poster
slots.description: Learn how to turn a family, couple, pet, or friend photo into a hand-drawn Bob’s Burgers-inspired poster with simple ordering and photo tips.
slots.intro: A Bob’s Burgers-inspired custom poster turns an everyday photo into warm, funny wall art starring your household as original cartoon characters. Explore our [custom Bob’s Burgers portrait](/portraits/bobs-burgers), or browse these [Bob’s Burgers-inspired poster gift ideas](/blog/bobs-burgers-inspired-poster-gift-ideas) before you order.
slots.sections: [{"heading":"What makes a Bob’s Burgers-inspired poster special?","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"The appeal is not just the thick outlines, cozy colours, or expressive eyebrows. It is the feeling of an ordinary family becoming the cast of its own small, lovable restaurant sitcom. A hand-drawn Bob’s Burgers-inspired custom poster can show your family behind a counter, gathered around a kitchen table, relaxing at home, or standing beside a completely fictional burger shop with a sign made especially for you."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"At Anime Cabinet, human artists draw each commission from your reference photos. The result is fan-art-inspired rather than a copied scene or an impersonation of copyrighted characters: your family becomes a group of original cartoon characters using a familiar visual language. Your hair, glasses, clothing, expressions, pets, and relationships remain part of the design."}]},{"heading":"How to order your custom poster from a photo","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"Ordering is designed to be straightforward, even if you have never commissioned artwork before. Start by choosing the Bob’s Burgers-inspired option and upload the clearest photos you have. You can use one group picture, several individual portraits, or a combination of both when everyone is not available in the same frame."},{"type":"list","items":["Choose the number of people and pets you want included.","Upload well-lit reference photos, ideally showing faces, hair, clothing, and body posture clearly.","Add notes about the scene, background, clothing changes, favourite colours, or a burger-shop sign.","Review your first preview within 72 hours under standard delivery.","Request unlimited free revisions until the artwork feels right for your household."]},{"type":"paragraph","text":"If you are unsure which photos work best, send the options that show personality. A goofy expression, a favourite hat, a familiar pose, or a pet’s distinctive markings can make the final custom bobs burgers portrait feel much more personal than a formally posed photograph."}]},{"heading":"What details should you provide for a Bob’s Burgers-inspired custom poster?","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"The artist can work with a simple idea, but useful notes help shape a more specific scene. Tell us who should appear, how people are related, and whether the mood should be relaxed, chaotic, celebratory, or gently ridiculous. Mention who is the most serious, who is always making jokes, and who should be holding the fries or standing behind the counter."},{"type":"list","items":["Names or roles for each person and pet, if you want a caption or sign.","Preferred clothing, including uniforms, sports shirts, workwear, or a favourite accessory.","A setting such as a home kitchen, seaside pier, burger counter, birthday table, or game-night room.","A custom restaurant name or burger-of-the-day pun for the background sign.","Any details that should not be changed, such as tattoos, glasses, hairstyles, or mobility aids.","The intended print size and whether the artwork is a gift, anniversary piece, housewarming present, or family display."]},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Bright, even lighting is especially helpful because this aesthetic uses clean, flat colour fields. Casual family photos in a living room or kitchen work beautifully, and goofy expressions are encouraged. If one person appears in a different photo, include several angles so the artist can match their features naturally."}]},{"heading":"Can an artist turn a family photo into this style?","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"Yes. A human artist can combine a family photo with separate individual references to create one cohesive composition. This is useful when relatives live in different places, a pet was not present for the group photograph, or you want to include someone who could not attend a celebration. The artist maps each person’s recognisable details into an original cartoon character while keeping the group visually balanced."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The proportions may be playful and cartoon-large, but the people should still look like your people. Hair shape, glasses, outfit colours, smiles, posture, and family dynamics all help preserve that recognition. You can use the revision stage to request changes to expressions, placement, background details, or the balance between characters."}]},{"heading":"Poster concepts for families, couples, and friends","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"A family behind a counter is a natural choice, especially with a custom burger name based on an inside joke. You might also place everyone around a kitchen table with a hand-lettered menu, or create a seaside scene where each person has a different snack and expression. Include every pet for a lively household portrait; cats, dogs, and other companions can receive the same personality-focused treatment as the human characters."},{"type":"list","items":["A couple portrait with a playful anniversary sign such as “Burger of the Month: Us.”","A best-friend duo at a pier, with one person holding fries and the other holding the order ticket.","A housewarming gift showing friends behind the counter of an imaginary neighbourhood restaurant.","A birthday poster for the energetic “Gene” or dramatic storyteller in your friend group, without copying any existing character.","A family celebration scene featuring favourite foods, party decorations, and a custom caption."]},{"type":"paragraph","text":"For more present-planning inspiration, see our guide to [Bob’s Burgers-inspired poster gift ideas](/blog/bobs-burgers-inspired-poster-gift-ideas).
